text: The Budget Subcommittee for City Hall and North York Civic Centre Consultation will hear public presentations on the 2019 Capital, Operating and Rate Supported Budgets at North York Civic Centre on January 11, 2019 from 3:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. At its meeting on January 28, 2019, the Budget Committee established two subcommittees to hear the public deputations on the 2019 Capital, Operating and Rate Supported Budgets at Scarborough Civic Centre, North York Civic Centre, Etobicoke Civic Centre and City Hall, and made appointments to the Subcommittees as follows: 2019 Budget Public Deputation Meetings Name of Subcommittee Members Meeting Dates, Locations and Times Budget Subcommittee for City Hall and North York Civic Centre Consultation Councillor Crawford (Chair) Councillor Carroll Councillor Layton February 7, 2019 City Hall 9:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; and 6:00 p.m. onwards February 11, 2019…
The Budget Subcommittee for City Hall and North York Civic Centre Consultations, received for information, the public presentations and the communications submitted by members of the public.
